title: Unicorn in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- horn -->
  <polygon points="50,8 44,30 56,30" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <polygon points="50,8 44,30 50,26" fill="#FFE55C"/>
  <line x1="47" y1="22" x2="53" y2="22" stroke="#FFC200" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="18" x2="54" y2="18" stroke="#FFC200" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="30" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#F0A0C8" transform="rotate(-15,38,30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="30" rx="3" ry="6" fill="#FFC0DC" transform="rotate(-15,38,30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="30" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#F0A0C8" transform="rotate(15,62,30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="30" rx="3" ry="6" fill="#FFC0DC" transform="rotate(15,62,30)"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#FFE8F2"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="40" r="4" fill="#3A2A6E"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="40" r="4" fill="#3A2A6E"/>
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="38.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="38.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#D48AA0"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#D48AA0"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M46,53 Q50,56 54,53" stroke="#D48AA0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="47" r="3" fill="#FFB0C8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="47" r="3" fill="#FFB0C8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d="M36,28 Q28,24 30,34 Q24,32 27,42 Q22,42 26,50" stroke="#FF6FA8" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64,28 Q72,24 70,34 Q76,32 73,42 Q78,42 74,50" stroke="#FF6FA8" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38,24 Q34,16 30,20" stroke="#C86FE0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62,24 Q66,16 70,20" stroke="#C86FE0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x="40" y="58" width="20" height="14" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M36,64 Q50,60 64,64 L64,72 Q50,68 36,72 Z" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <path d="M60,70 L70,82 L64,84 L56,72 Z" fill="#29B6F6"/>
  <path d="M60,70 L66,78 L62,80 L56,72 Z" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="66" r="2" fill="#0288D1"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="24" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="18" ry="7" fill="#FFE8F2"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="34" y="88" width="7" height="10" rx="3" fill="#F0A0C8"/>
  <rect x="59" y="88" width="7" height="10" rx="3" fill="#F0A0C8"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M74,80 Q84,76 82,86 Q80,94 86,92" stroke="#FF6FA8" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M74,84 Q82,82 80,90" stroke="#C86FE0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
